SB007/14                               VALID: 12-OCT-14 0330 - UFN
  SB007/14 COMPANY NOTAM
  WHEN PLANNING A COST INDEX, 2 OPTIONS ARE AVAILABLE. PILOTS MAY
  EITHER SELECT A SPECIFIC COST INDEX NUMBER FROM THE LIST, OR THEY
  MAY SELECT "AUTO". WHEN PLANNING AN "AUTO" COST INDEX, THE SYSTEM
  WILL REFERENCE THE SCHEDULED "TIME ENROUTE" OPTION AND ATTEMPT TO
  CHOOSE A COST INDEX WHICH CLOSELY MATCHES THIS VALUE. NOTE THAT
  THE "TIME ENROUTE" OPTION IS MEANT AS A GATE TO GATE TIME (AS
  INDICATED ON AN AIRLINE'S FLIGHT SCHEDULE, FOR EXAMPLE). IF A
  "TIME ENROUTE" OF 2:30 IS SELECTED, THE SYSTEM WILL SUBTRACT THE
  TAXI TIMES FROM THIS VALUE TO DETERMINE THE SCHEDULED AIR TIME. IT
  WILL THEN DETERMINE AND USE THE COST INDEX WHICH MATCHES THIS AIR
  TIME.

SB003/13                               VALID: 13-JUL-13 0320 - UFN
  SB003/13 COMPANY NOTAM
  ALL FLIGHT CREW: PLEASE PAY SPECIAL ATTENTION TO THE UNITS
  SELECTION WHEN GENERATING A FLIGHT PLAN. FAILURE TO IDENTIFY THE
  CORRECT UNITS WHEN REFUELING PRIOR TO FLIGHT CAN RESULT IN
  DEPARTING WITH INSUFFICIENT FUEL AND/OR AN ERRONEOUS PAYLOAD.

E1428/25                               VALID: 13-JUN-25 1727 - UFN
  FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY IS REGULATED AS FLW:
  -AIRCRAFT NOT INVOLVED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS MUST NOT
  FLY OVER THE FIRE AREA AND MUST EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION
  WHEN FLYING NEAR IT, CONSIDERING THE POSSIBLE INTERVENTION
  OF FIREFIGHTING ACFT.
  THEREFORE, WHEN AN AERIAL FIREFIGHTING OPERATION IS
  ANNOUNCED/ACTIVE, IT IS PROHIBITED TO FLY IN THE ZONES IDENTIFIED
  BY THE FIRE-FIGHTING AUTHORITIES AND NOTIFIED BY THE COMPETENT
  AUTHORITY OR, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:
  I. WITHIN CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC
  COMMUNICATIONS ABOUT THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE FIREFIGHTING
  OPERATIONS FROM THE ENGAGED ACFT, BELOW 760M (2500FT) AGL
  WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 4KM
  (2 NM) FROM THE FIRE
  II. OUTSIDE CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, BELOW 900M (3000FT) AGL,
  WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 9KM
  (5NM) FROM THE FIRE.
  -TIMELY UPDATES REGARDING THE ZONES AND AREAS AFFECTED
  CAN BE BROADCAST ON GROUND/AIR/GROUND FREQUENCIES.
  PART 1 OF 2
  
  -THE ENGAGED FIREFIGHTING AIRCRAFT KEEP THE ATS UNIT
  RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AFFECTED AREA INFORMED ABOUT THE
  FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS AND THEIR CONCLUSION.
  -THE ATS UNIT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE
  FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS PROVIDES AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES, AS FAR
  AS POSSIBLE:
  1.TO THE AIRCRAFT ENGAGED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS, EXCEPT
  IN THE FIREFIGHTING AREA WHERE IT PROVIDES ONLY FLIGHT INFORMATION
  AND ALERT SERVICES.
  RMK: IF A CTR IS AFFECTED BY THE FIRE, SID/STAR/INSTR APCH PROC
  COULD BE TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED OR MODIFIED
  2.TO OTHER GAT FLIGHTS, BASED ON THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE
  REGARDING THE FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY, WHICH MAY STILL BE
  INCOMPLETE.
  REF AIP ENR 1.1.1.4 'POLICE, CUSTOMS AND PATROL FLIGHTS ENGAGED IN
  URGENCY MISSIONS', PARAGRAPH C 'FIREFIGHTING'
  PART 2 OF 2

E1428/25                               VALID: 13-JUN-25 1727 - UFN
  FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY IS REGULATED AS FLW:
  -AIRCRAFT NOT INVOLVED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS MUST NOT
  FLY OVER THE FIRE AREA AND MUST EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION
  WHEN FLYING NEAR IT, CONSIDERING THE POSSIBLE INTERVENTION
  OF FIREFIGHTING ACFT.
  THEREFORE, WHEN AN AERIAL FIREFIGHTING OPERATION IS
  ANNOUNCED/ACTIVE, IT IS PROHIBITED TO FLY IN THE ZONES IDENTIFIED
  BY THE FIRE-FIGHTING AUTHORITIES AND NOTIFIED BY THE COMPETENT
  AUTHORITY OR, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:
  I. WITHIN CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC
  COMMUNICATIONS ABOUT THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE FIREFIGHTING
  OPERATIONS FROM THE ENGAGED ACFT, BELOW 760M (2500FT) AGL
  WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 4KM
  (2 NM) FROM THE FIRE
  II. OUTSIDE CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, BELOW 900M (3000FT) AGL,
  WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 9KM
  (5NM) FROM THE FIRE.
  -TIMELY UPDATES REGARDING THE ZONES AND AREAS AFFECTED
  CAN BE BROADCAST ON GROUND/AIR/GROUND FREQUENCIES.
  PART 1 OF 2
  
  -THE ENGAGED FIREFIGHTING AIRCRAFT KEEP THE ATS UNIT
  RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AFFECTED AREA INFORMED ABOUT THE
  FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS AND THEIR CONCLUSION.
  -THE ATS UNIT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE
  FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS PROVIDES AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES, AS FAR
  AS POSSIBLE:
  1.TO THE AIRCRAFT ENGAGED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS, EXCEPT
  IN THE FIREFIGHTING AREA WHERE IT PROVIDES ONLY FLIGHT INFORMATION
  AND ALERT SERVICES.
  RMK: IF A CTR IS AFFECTED BY THE FIRE, SID/STAR/INSTR APCH PROC
  COULD BE TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED OR MODIFIED
  2.TO OTHER GAT FLIGHTS, BASED ON THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE
  REGARDING THE FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY, WHICH MAY STILL BE
  INCOMPLETE.
  REF AIP ENR 1.1.1.4 'POLICE, CUSTOMS AND PATROL FLIGHTS ENGAGED IN
  URGENCY MISSIONS', PARAGRAPH C 'FIREFIGHTING'
  PART 2 OF 2
